personality_one_liner: A cinematic dark-mode mobile app UI with a near-black background, poster-focused content cards, violet accent actions, minimal chrome, and sleek typography that feels like a modern film diary.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use blur on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
Use blur on the pinned filter/category chips row (e.g., Filmes, Séries, Mangás) when scrolling.
Use a frosted glass overlay with a brandTertiary base on floating action buttons or sticky CTAs.
dont's: Never blur body content, form fields, or standard grid cards.

screens.name: Explorar
screens.purpose: A cinematic discovery hub featuring a search bar, category chips, and a grid of media posters fetched from external APIs.

states.loading: Centered spinner or grid of poster-shaped skeletons.
states.empty: Glass-morphic search icon with text 'Busque por filmes, séries, mangás ou livros' and a clear CTA.
states.error: Readable error message 'Não foi possível carregar os resultados' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header containing the Search Bar and horizontal scrollable Category Chips (Filmes, Séries, Mangás, Livros). Below, a 2-column 'hybrid grid' (poster image aspect ratio 2:3 + short info containing Title and Year/Rating below it). Space between columns is 'md'.

screens.name: Biblioteca
screens.purpose: The user's central hub for saved items across all media types, with local filtering and sorting.

states.empty: Illustration/icon of an empty shelf with 'Sua biblioteca está vazia' and a CTA 'Explorar títulos'.

screens.layout: Large header 'Biblioteca' followed by a horizontal scrollable row of Sort/Filter pills (Recentes, Avaliação, Título). The main content is the same 2-column hybrid poster grid.

screens.name: Favoritos
screens.purpose: A dedicated grid for the user's highest-rated or starred items.

states.empty: Icon of a star with text 'Nenhum favorito ainda' and a CTA 'Ver biblioteca'.

screens.layout: Similar to Biblioteca, 2-column hybrid grid emphasizing the posters.

screens.name: Quero Consumir
screens.purpose: A watchlist of items the user plans to watch/read in the future.

states.empty: Icon of a bookmark/clock with text 'Sua lista está vazia'.

screens.layout: 2-column hybrid grid showing poster and title.

screens.name: Detalhes
screens.purpose: A cinematic item detail modal showing full metadata, synopsis, and actionable status controls.

states.loading: Skeleton of a hero image and title.
states.empty: Not applicable (data passed directly or loaded).
states.error: Error message indicating the item details couldn't be fetched.

screens.layout: Full-bleed backdrop image at the top with a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Item title overlays the bottom of the scrim. Below the title, a row of metadata chips (Year, Rating, Genres). A text block for the Synopsis. A sticky primary CTA button ('Adicionar à Biblioteca' or 'Alterar Status') pinned to the bottom of the screen inside a safe area container, with a glass background behind the button. Secondary action icon buttons ('Favoritar', 'Quero Consumir') placed alongside.

movie_poster_placeholder.alt: Collection of cinematic movie posters under dark neon light

manga_cover_placeholder.alt: Anime or manga style artwork placeholder

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's request for Portuguese (Brazilian) labels across the app (Explorar, Biblioteca, Favoritos, Quero Consumir, Detalhes).
Theme Rule: Execute a deep cinematic dark mode (surface: #09090E) with the user-requested violet/purple accent (#9D4EDD). Do not use indigo/blue.

Grid Layout: The 'hybrid grid' means rendering exactly 2 columns of items using flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', and justifyContent: 'space-between'. The poster image should have an aspect ratio of 2:3. Below the poster, render the Title (numberOfLines={1}) and a small metadata string (Year or Rating).

Image Gradient Scrim: On the 'Detalhes' screen, the hero image MUST have a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (using expo-linear-gradient) over it: 'transparent' at 0% -> 'rgba(9, 9, 14, 0.4)' at 50% -> 'rgba(9, 9, 14, 1)' at 100%. This ensures the overlaying title text achieves WCAG contrast.
Bottom Tabs: Implement 4 tabs with icons representing Explore, Library, Favorites, and Watchlist. Tab bar should use glassmorphism where supported.

Sticky Actions: On the 'Detalhes' screen, keep the main CTA button ('Adicionar à Biblioteca' or Status changer) sticky at the bottom over the scrollable content. Give its container a subtle glass effect so text scrolls visibly underneath.
Typography: Use Outfit for headings and Geist for body text. Ensure all font weights are max 500.

Empty States: Each tab (Biblioteca, Favoritos, Quero Consumir) needs a distinct full-screen empty state utilizing Phosphor icons, a short Portuguese sentence, and an optional CTA to navigate to Explorar.
